gen-gf-oxanium-satoshi: Commanding and a little futuristic, Oxanium draws its tall lowercase in single unbroken lines. Satoshi takes the quieter job, with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, while Oxanium handles the loud, distinctive display work.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, every lowercase letter standing tall on its line. New Title does its best work up top, bold and modern, while Bespoke Slab is built to carry a classic serif's steady text.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-esteban: Esteban reads like a classic serif with oversized lowercase and thin strokes only a touch lighter than its stems. New Title is the bold one up top; Esteban just keeps talking.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-faustina: Letters locked together like links in a fine chain give New Title its bold, modern look. And Faustina, a serif with an open-jawed c and gracefully thinning bowls, can take a generous size without losing its authority.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-halant: New Title locks its tall lowercase together like links in a fine chain, bold and modern. Halant brings the traditional counterweight, a text serif with towering x-height, outward-pointing terminals and soft shifts in thickness that never turn stark.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: New Title leads with bold, modern letters locked together like links in a fine chain. And Hedvig Letters Serif follows with sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase and open curves, a text serif with medium-key contrast that gives the page room to breathe.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, with terminals pulled well back. Its gentle stroke modulation is the pair's strongest quality, a calm serif foil to New Title's chain-linked boldness.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads traditional and refined, its robust downstrokes meeting slender turns, with a sizable x-height and an open channel in the e. New Title earns its keep big and short.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-hentaigan: New Title brings bold, modern lowercase locked together like links in a fine chain. But Noto Serif Hentaigana, a classic serif with open jaws on every curve, gives the pair its strongest quality: restrained, visible modulation under the display punch.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-ovo: Ovo is a classic serif with thins only slightly lighter than its thicks. New Title lends bold, modern punch up top, while Ovo's tall middle band and spacious curve terminals keep the text below it unhurried.
